result.topic_en: Opening page of the section 'Old unsolved questions', reprinting question 703 (Boncompagni, on sums of cubes in arithmetic progression) and the beginning of question 724 (a cone over the intersection of a sphere and a quadric).
result.transcription:
ANCIENNES QUESTIONS NON RÉSOLUES.

703 (1864, 176). — Déterminer des valeurs entières des quantités $x$, $n$, $r$ :
1° Telles que la somme
$$x^3+(x+r)^3+\ldots+[x+(n-1)r]^3$$
soit un cube;
2° Telles que cette somme soit le cube de $x+nr$.
B. BONCOMPAGNI.

questions.statement_en:
Determine integer values of the quantities $x$, $n$, $r$:
1° Such that the sum
$$x^3+(x+r)^3+\ldots+[x+(n-1)r]^3$$
is a cube;
2° Such that this sum is the cube of $x+nr$.
